avis.texte: My favorite cleanser ever! Makes my skin feel great, and has the most amazing scent!
Love the superfood facial cleaner. Have been using it for almost two years. Skin feels soft and very refreshed.
Leaves skin feeling clean and refreshed without drying. I use this along with the superfood drops.

I've been using the Super Food Facial Wash Cleanser for a few weeks now, and overall I'm really impressed. It cleanses deeply without leaving my skin feeling tight or stripped. My face feels soft and refreshed after every wash.

My favorite Elemis face wash. I'm 62 have very sensitive skin and absolutely adore this wash! It lathers nicely, leaves no trace of makeup behind, my skin never feels dried out, and has a lovely spa scent. I hope this soap is never discontinued. It truly is wonderful!

Got small size tube of cleanser as a Christmas gift. It works gentlly on my face yet provides a deep cleanse. I use this cleanser with PMD Clean brush. Plan to upgrade to large size, since it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin.
I love this cleanser. It's super hydrating and it's great at taking off make up. been using it for years
Really like the cleanser. Leaves my skin smooth and clean and I really like the fresh smell
This is a good product as I have used it before, however I never received my order placed in November.

cleans completely and is refreshing. I cleanse with this product at night. I have mature skin after I clean with this product night with night pro collagen moisturizing cream. I use a pro collagen moisturizing balm in morning.
I love this face wash! It's gentle on my skin, I feel clean without anything important being stripped away.
Leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed. I don't get that tight feeling and it rinses off easily. I prefer the gel cleansers over the cleansing balm.

I love the product. One pump is enough for a deep face wash and it smells very nice as well. My face feels clean and not over stripped or dried out. I'm of the age where my skin is much dryer than it used to be and so far this is a good product for my aging skin.

I purchased this to help diminish redness, after I used the Elemis virtual face recommendation….been using for 2 weeks and notice the redness diminishing!! I enjoy the scent, using it with the Superfood Oil…seems to be doing its job!😉

I like this cleanser and have now purchased it 3 times. I tend to switch brands but this one is definitely a winner for me. I have 40's skin and some fine lines/wrinkles and a combo skin type. This does not break me out, it's gentle but leaves my skin feeling clean.
This product cleans exactly the way I want it to with a very nice aroma. My face always feels fresh after and not red or rough. I'm glad I found it.

I bought this on the recommendation of an associate in Ulta after he saw the redness in my face. I'm always up for a change, so i went with it. The first time that i used it, I noticed how "earthy" the smell is, but not a good earthy, I didn't like it. Luckily, the smell didn't stick around long. After several weeks of use, my skin felt horrible. My red cheeks were so dry that i was having trouble moisturizing them enough. Needless to say, I threw the face wash away and tried to restore the balance of my skin for the next months.
I highly recommend this yummy product. I bought it because of the sample that I received. this facial wash works great on my mature skin.

avis.titre: Not enthused by this facial wash.
avis.texte: I think this is a harsher facial wash. I also think the bottle I got was at the end of its shelf life, it smelled old.
Leaves my skin soft and smooth, and I love how my face looks and feels. It's my new go to cleanser, thanks to Elemis!

I am genuinely disappointed with the performance of this cleanser. It marks the first time I have been dissatisfied with an Elemis product. I sincerely hope that Elemis does not succumb to the decline in quality that often affects many other brands over time.
I like this. It's nourishing and gentle. Oh yeah, it cleans well—and I am something of a grease monkey.
Not bad but not my favorite. It doesnt remove makeup well, even non waterproof mascara. I like the formulation and dont mind the earthy smell. I got it during the sale but wouldnt pay full price.
I'm not nuts about the smell BUT, I Love how it cleans my face, it's even better than Clinique!

avis.titre: Dried my skin / smell is so strong
avis.texte: I've purchased a few items from this brand since I tried one of their pro collagen products and I really liked it however I have discovered that their smells are extremely overpowering such as this product. The pro collagen smells more like eucalyptus and fresh whole this smells different I can't explain the smell it's like a bad old lady perfume. I tried this a a few days and it overly dried my skin it just wasn't making my skin feel nice. I tried it with their rose oil and Holly Molly the smells combined actually gave me a migraine, also for reference my skin was so dried from the wash that no matter how much oil I applied it did not feel hydrated enough I had to return. I have normal skin I supposed more on the dry side
Irritating and smelly . I can't belive so many people give them good reviews . The color is nasty too ! Yucks

I bought this product. The smell of it is SO BAD!!! I tried it once and I could not stand the smell. I was hoping it would have the clean smell like the cleansing balm. I also felt it was very drying. I REACHED OUT TO CUSTOMER SERVICE AND I HAVE HEARD NOTHING BACK. HUGE DISAPPOINTMENT!!!!!!

avis.titre: So glad to have finished the bottle
avis.texte: I purchased this during the 50% off sale, thinking, *how bad could it be?* Unfortunately, it turned out to be the worst cleanser I've ever used. First, it burns your eyes. The packaging says to avoid the eye area, which I've never seen with a cleanser before. This is not only inconvenient but also challenging because you have to avoid your forehead as well to prevent it from dripping into your eyes. If you wear makeup, like I do, this makes it even less practical. On top of that, it never left my skin feeling truly clean. I would avoid this product at all costs.
Has a fresh, faint, herbal scent. Cleans without drying out my skin and leaves it feeling soft and fresh. Very concentrated so a little bit goes a long way.

I saw this pop up as a 1-day special deal and grabbed it on a whim. It's one of the best impulse buys I've ever made. It smells amazing and my skin feels so good. I'll definitely be buying more when this gets low!
I've been using this for about 5 months and it has been a game changer for my skin. the smell is so spa- like and I love the clean feeling on my skin.
Best ever facial wash. I only have to use a half pump because that's all it takes to do my face and neck. Leaves my skin soft, squeaky clean and fresh.
This cleanser is fantastic. It cleanses my skin without making it feel dry. My face actually feels refreshed after washing with this. I am so impressed with it I bought one for my sister!
I love this face wash. It's gentle, smells amazing and leaves my skin feeling beautiful!

avis.titre: I couldn't use it due to the strong smell.
avis.texte: For me the smell is very strong and repulsive. Because of him, I couldn't evaluate the quality. Threw it away
This has to be the most refreshing face wash i have ever used.
Like a mini spa treatment, cleans gently and smells amazing!!
This is a really great product. It doesn't break me out and it doesn't dry me out.
Love the way the face wash makes my skin feel plus the smell is amazing. I am 64 years old and it makes my skin feel soft and hydrated. You definitely need to try this.

avis.titre: Feels like your in a spa!
avis.texte: My skin feels soft and clean. The smell is fresh, and it reminds me of being in a spa.

This is the best cleanser I have ever used. My skin feels so clean and smooth after I use it. This is the only cleanser I've used for the past year and also have not had one breakout. Highly recommended.
I love the way my skin fels after using the superfood facial wash. My skin feels hydrated and I can see the difference this had made on the texture of my skin!
Love this product! It has a nice spa smell which is relaxing. I feel I get a deep cleaning as well. Even removes my makeup.
I really liked the toner and will continue to test it. The first impression is great

One of my favorite cleansing products from Elemis . This one and the creamy cleanser are my top 2 favorites . This one has a great pump , leaves my skin clean but not dry . It really cleanses well along with the cleansing balm to remove all makeup residue .
Love this cleanser. Leaves face feeling clean and soft. I am addicted to how it smells!
My face feels so clean when I use this. And I haven't broken out since I started!!! It's really nice because I suffer from adult acne. But my skin is sooo smooth!!!
I love this face wash so much. Way more than you should love a face wash.
Second time buying, use in the morning for a very gentle cleanse.
Smells amazing and leaves your skin feeling the same. Two small pumps is all you need.
I like the clean fresh smell. The pump makes it easy to use in the shower. The pump makes it last longer.

I have never had an allergic reaction before from skin care but after one use of this my entire face and neck broke out in hives. I do not have particularly sensitive skin so I am not sure why this happened and I know a lot of people enjoy this product but if you happen to have an allergic reaction you are definitely not alone. I will be returning product.

avis.titre: Love the feel of my skin after!
avis.texte: I love this stuff! The texture is a bit grainy, and I feel like it's a really nice, yet gentle exfoliant. I know that's not what it's advertised to do, but it makes my skin feels really smooth after use. I don't use it every day as it dries my skin out a little but once/twice a week is perfect!
I love this cleanser! Makes my skin feel clean and soft without feeling stripped. A definite go-to favorite

This face wash smells deliciously green, clean, and not at al overwhelming. It is a gel-like consistency, with some suds as you wash. I use this in the morning when my skin is free from make-up and it's just the perfect cleanser prior to putting on sunscreen, moisturizer, and make-up. I like that it doesn't dry out my skin either. I wouldn't recommend this for make-up removal but it feels really gentle and is effective.
My go too face wash. Gentle and not overly stripping. Nice green scent ☺️
Love this facial wash work's wonderful and smell great. Highly recommend

Nourishing and leaves skin feeling fresh. This hydrating cleanser feels like putting fresh greens on your skin. It feels organic and effective. It smells great and not too heavily. I use this after the cleansing balm or by itself for a lighter effect.

I have been using this for years, after initially receiving a sample of it. I like the natural scent even if it is a bit "earthy", and it's gentle yet effective. I use it every morning, and a different brand's exfoliating/acne cleanser nightly. The combo balances my mid-40s skin very well. While the bottle is pricey, it lasts for several months since you only need a pea-sized drop to clean your whole face. Lathers very well.
Excellent cleanser. Leaves skin yet feeling hydrated. Lovely light scent
This cleanser does a thorough job and cleansing the skin, without stripping it.
Another amazing product from Elemis!! Great product, generous size for the price! Face feels, looks and smells fantastic…love the superfood line!!

I've gone through a lot of cleansers from drug store to more natural to more expensive. This one has been wonderful. The smell is whatever, but once I rinse it off, I don't smell it anymore. It didn't deter me, at least. I noticed that my skin looked less irritated and smoother when using this. It wasn't a shocking difference, but enough for me to notice and feel more confident about going without makeup. I've never felt that stripped-of-all-oils kind of tightness and still, my pore look cleaner. If I wear makeup, I start with a Make Up Eraser cloth and then use this afterwards and it removes everything.
Had to get it for my trip and absolutely loved it. Bought two more to use when I travel.
I love the smell of this. It reminds me of a product I used to use ages ago. Doesn't leave my skin dry, but fresh and clean.
Awesome priducts that goes on gently but cleanses deeply. I pair it with the moisturizer and end up with a glowy finish every time.
I'm obsessed with this cleanser. It is gentle but so effective. My face feels clean and my pores are tight but not stripped or over dry.

I really love this for my "normal" skin. It smells clean. My skin feels great after I use it, not stripped. I use it after an oil based cleanser at night and by itself in the morning. This is my 3rd repurchase and I'll continue to use it.

I'm older, have oily skin, and live in a hot, humid environment so finding the right product has been a challenge. I needed a good cleansing agent that leaves my face squeaky clean before using my moisturizing face wash. This product works perfect for me. Will buy again.
Love this cleanser, using it now while prone to seasonal allergies. Feels so cleansing and soothing. I would love to see a body wash version also!
I don't like it I have normal skin and this leave my skin so oily that looks like I didn't wash it
I alternate between using this wash and the cleansing balm. My husband also uses this wash and loves the smell and how its gentle yet effective.
I love this cleanser and especially the way it smells. The aromas are so amazing.
My face feels so good and refreshed after I use it...not dry or oily but just right, balanced!
I think this is a fine cleanser but it may be making me breakout. I'm not sure if it is the cleanser or the moisturizer I started at the same time.
It's dusty and dry in the desert and I needed some GREEN … Shake it … then Lather up in the shower and walaa … removed everything. Refreshingly GREEN
This is the only face wash I use on a daily basis. I love it. Makes my skin feel so good and the smell is amazing.

avis.titre: Influencers got me.. but not worth it
avis.texte: Bad product and worse service. I'll not repurchase this or any other product from here. It was super small even for what I paid. Overpriced and I could get a better product for less $. Thanks.
What a wonderful product! Very gentle and leaves my face glowing and supple.
Feels SO GOOD on the skin. Instantly your skin feels nourished.
Super hydrating and replenishing! Absolutely love this product!
Nice cleanser! I have tried the Cica foaming cleanser and was curious about this one, as good as a foaming one! Love it!
Loving this facewash. It does have a small to it but it's not bad at all. I have been using this facewash for a week and it's already improved my skin. Love whats in it!

Gentle cleanser that is nourishing. The Superfood products won't disappoint no matter what age range. Starting with a great cleanser like the prebiotic cleanser. Love the smell too! Loving the superfood product line and all the goodness it delivers.
It left my face smooth and clean I have only been using it for 2 days now on my trip
im in love with this. i use it every morning + night and it makes me feel so revitalized in the mornings. my only complaint is the price but other than that i love it
I have extremely sensitive skin but this does not irritate it at all. It does an amazing job lathering and removing makeup. I highly recommend this!

avis.titre: Wish I could give a zero
avis.texte: Breakouts breakouts breakouts. My face is a million times worse after using it for just two nights. My skin looks disgusting from this.
Smells great, and feels great. It's gentle on my face, and yet it removes make up easily. I won't use any other product clean my face.

This is my favorite cleanser, I don't think I will ever buy any other brand. My skin has been gorgeous since I started using it. I feel like my face is so nourished after using, it's as if I am taking years off of my age every time I wash.
